import math

enum TokenKind
    Number
    Offset
    Current
    Last
    Comma
    Semicolon
    Whole
    Mark
    Forward
    Backward

enum Kind
    PrintLast
    Append
    Insert
    Change
    Print
    Numbered
    List
    Equal
    Count
    Yank
    Marks
    History
    Files
    Delete
    Put
    Join
    JoinWords
    Page
    Indent
    Outdent
    Undo
    Redo
    Read
    PrintWrite
    Write
    AppendFile
    Edit
    Mark
    Move
    Copy
    Substitute
    LetterCase
    Sort
    Global

class ReplacementPart(string text, matched := false)

class Delimited(string text, ReplacementPart[] parts, string raw, int next)

class Token(TokenKind kind, word := "")

class Scanned(Token[] tokens, string tail)

class Addresses(int count, Token[] left := [], semicolon := false, Token[] right := [])

class LineRange(int first, int last)

class Substitution(search := "", ReplacementPart[] replacement := [], previous := true, all := false, count := 1)

class Action(Kind kind, argument := "", amount := -1, suffix := "", Token[] destination := [], substitution := Substitution())

class Global(string search, bool inverse, Action action)

class Line(int id, string text)

class Record(string source, Line[] buffer, int current)

class State()
    Line[] buffer := []
    current := 0
    int[26] marks := array(26, fill = 0)
    string[] cut := []
    string | none pattern := none
    ReplacementPart[] | none replacement := none
    display_count := 5
    Record[] undo := []
    Record[] redo := []
    files := map<string, string[]>()
    next_id := 1

class Editor(state := State(), string[] output := [])

bool includes<T>(const T[] values, T sought)
    for value := values[]
        if value == sought
            return true
    return false

bool digit(string value)
    return #value == 1 and "0123456789".contains(value)

bool all_digits(string text)
    for point := text.codepoints()[]
        if point < 48 or point > 57
            return false
    return true

int digits_end(string text, int start)
    position := start
    while position < int(#text) and digit(text[position])
        position += 1
    return position

int find_index(string text, string needle)
    match text.find(needle)
        nat position
            return int(position)
        none
            return -1

Delimited | error delimited(string source, int start, string delimiter)
    text := ""
    ReplacementPart[] parts := []
    position := start
    while position < int(#source)
        ch := source[position]
        if ch == "\"
            position += 1
            if position == int(#source)
                return error("missing delimiter")
            ch = source[position]
            text += ch
            parts = parts.append(ReplacementPart(ch))
        elif ch == delimiter
            return Delimited(text, parts, source[start:<position], position + 1)
        else
            text += ch
            parts = parts.append(ReplacementPart(ch, ch == "&"))
        position += 1
    return error("missing delimiter")

Scanned | error scan_address(string source)
    Token[] tokens := []
    position := 0
    while position < int(#source)
        ch := source[position]
        if digit(ch) or ch == "+" or ch == "-"
            start := position
            position = digits_end(source, position + 1)
            tokens = tokens.append(Token(if digit(ch) then TokenKind.Number else TokenKind.Offset, source[start:<position]))
        elif ".$,;%".contains(ch)
            TokenKind[] kinds := [TokenKind.Current, TokenKind.Last, TokenKind.Comma, TokenKind.Semicolon, TokenKind.Whole]
            tokens = tokens.append(Token(kinds[find_index(".$,;%", ch)]))
            position += 1
        elif ch == "'"
            position += 1
            name := ""
            if position < int(#source)
                name = source[position]
                position += 1
            tokens = tokens.append(Token(TokenKind.Mark, name))
        elif ch == "/" or ch == "?"
            found := try delimited(source, position + 1, ch)
            tokens = tokens.append(Token(if ch == "/" then TokenKind.Forward else TokenKind.Backward, found.text))
            position = found.next
        else
            break
    return Scanned(tokens, source[position:])

bool valid_address(const Token[] tokens)
    TokenKind[] bases := [TokenKind.Number, TokenKind.Current, TokenKind.Last, TokenKind.Mark, TokenKind.Forward, TokenKind.Backward]
    for: index < #tokens
        if tokens[index].kind != TokenKind.Offset and (index != 0 or not includes(bases, tokens[index].kind))
            return false
    return true

Addresses | error address_form(const Token[] tokens)
    if #tokens == 0
        return Addresses(0)
    if #tokens == 1 and tokens[0].kind == TokenKind.Whole
        return Addresses(2, [Token(TokenKind.Number, "1")], right = [Token(TokenKind.Last)])
    separator := -1
    for: index < #tokens
        if tokens[index].kind == TokenKind.Comma or tokens[index].kind == TokenKind.Semicolon
            if separator >= 0
                return error("bad address")
            separator = int(index)
    if separator < 0
        if not valid_address(tokens)
            return error("bad address")
        return Addresses(1, tokens)
    left := tokens[0:<separator]
    right := tokens[separator + 1:]
    if not valid_address(left) or not valid_address(right)
        return error("bad address")
    return Addresses(2, left, tokens[separator].kind == TokenKind.Semicolon, right)

int | error positive_argument(string argument)
    if argument == ""
        return -1
    if not all_digits(argument)
        return error("invalid suffix")
    value := int(argument)
    if value == 0
        return error("invalid suffix")
    return value

string | error print_suffix(string argument)
    if argument != "" and (#argument != 1 or not "pnl".contains(argument))
        return error("invalid suffix")
    return argument

string | error file_name(string argument)
    if #argument < 2 or #argument > 9 or argument[0] != " "
        return error("invalid file name")
    name := argument[1:]
    for point := name.codepoints()[]
        if not (97 <= point <= 122 or 48 <= point <= 57)
            return error("invalid file name")
    return name

bool sort_form(string source)
    return source == "sort" or source.starts_with("sort ")

Action | error parse_substitution(string argument)
    substitution := Substitution()
    flags := argument
    repeated := true
    for: index < #argument
        if not "gpnl".contains(argument[index]) and not digit(argument[index])
            repeated = false
    if not repeated
        delimiter := argument[0]
        if delimiter == " " or delimiter == "\"
            return error("missing delimiter")
        search := try delimited(argument, 1, delimiter)
        replace := try delimited(argument, search.next, delimiter)
        substitution.search = search.text
        substitution.replacement = replace.parts
        substitution.previous = replace.raw == "%"
        flags = argument[replace.next:]
    counted := false
    suffix := ""
    position := 0
    while position < int(#flags)
        ch := flags[position]
        position += 1
        if ch == "g"
            if substitution.all
                return error("invalid suffix")
            substitution.all = true
        elif "pnl".contains(ch)
            if suffix != ""
                return error("invalid suffix")
            suffix = ch
        elif digit(ch)
            if counted
                return error("invalid suffix")
            counted = true
            start := position - 1
            position = digits_end(flags, position)
            substitution.count = int(flags[start:<position])
            if substitution.count == 0
                return error("invalid suffix")
        else
            return error("invalid suffix")
    return Action(Kind.Substitute, suffix = suffix, substitution = substitution)

Action | error parse_action(string source)
    if sort_form(source)
        options := if source == "sort" then "" else source[5:]
        if source != "sort"
            if options == ""
                return error("invalid suffix")
            seen := ""
            for: index < #options
                option := options[index]
                if not "ruin".contains(option) or seen.contains(option)
                    return error("invalid suffix")
                seen += option
            if options.contains("i") and options.contains("n")
                return error("invalid suffix")
        return Action(Kind.Sort, argument = options)
    if source == ""
        return Action(Kind.PrintLast)
    first := source[0]
    argument := source[1:]
    simple := find_index("aicpnl=#yKhf", first)
    if simple >= 0
        if argument != ""
            return error("invalid suffix")
        Kind[] kinds := [Kind.Append, Kind.Insert, Kind.Change, Kind.Print, Kind.Numbered, Kind.List, Kind.Equal, Kind.Count, Kind.Yank, Kind.Marks, Kind.History, Kind.Files]
        return Action(kinds[simple])
    if "dxjJ".contains(first)
        Kind[] kinds := [Kind.Delete, Kind.Put, Kind.Join, Kind.JoinWords]
        return Action(kinds[find_index("dxjJ", first)], suffix = try print_suffix(argument))
    if "z><u".contains(first)
        Kind[] kinds := [Kind.Page, Kind.Indent, Kind.Outdent, Kind.Undo]
        return Action(kinds[find_index("z><u", first)], amount = try positive_argument(argument))
    if first == "~"
        if argument != "" and argument != "u" and argument != "l"
            return error("invalid suffix")
        return Action(Kind.LetterCase, argument = argument)
    if first == "r"
        if all_digits(argument)
            return Action(Kind.Redo, amount = try positive_argument(argument))
        return Action(Kind.Read, argument = try file_name(argument))
    if first == "w"
        if argument == ""
            return Action(Kind.PrintWrite)
        return Action(Kind.Write, argument = try file_name(argument))
    if first == "W" or first == "e"
        return Action(if first == "W" then Kind.AppendFile else Kind.Edit, argument = try file_name(argument))
    if first == "k"
        if #argument != 1 or not "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz".contains(argument)
            return error("invalid mark")
        return Action(Kind.Mark, argument = argument)
    if first == "m" or first == "t"
        destination := try scan_address(argument)
        if #destination.tokens == 0 or not valid_address(destination.tokens)
            return error("invalid destination")
        return Action(if first == "m" then Kind.Move else Kind.Copy, suffix = try print_suffix(destination.tail), destination = destination.tokens)
    if first == "s"
        return try parse_substitution(argument)
    return error("unknown command")

Action | Global | error parse_command(string source)
    if #source > 0 and (source[0] == "g" or source[0] == "v")
        if #source < 2 or source[1] == " " or source[1] == "\"
            return error("missing delimiter")
        search := try delimited(source, 2, source[1])
        body := source[search.next:]
        if body == ""
            body = "p"
        if not "pnldmtjJs><~aicx".contains(body[0]) or sort_form(body)
            return error("invalid global command")
        action := try parse_action(body)
        return Global(search.text, source[0] == "v", action)
    return try parse_action(source)

bool | error text_form(string source)
    scanned := try scan_address(source)
    tail := scanned.tail
    if tail == "a" or tail == "i" or tail == "c"
        return true
    if #tail < 2 or not "gv".contains(tail[0]) or tail[1] == " " or tail[1] == "\"
        return false
    search := try delimited(tail, 2, tail[1])
    body := tail[search.next:]
    return body == "a" or body == "i" or body == "c"

bool with_text(string source)
    match text_form(source)
        bool found
            return found
        error
            return false

Kind command_kind(const Action | Global command)
    match command
        Action action
            return action.kind
        Global
            return Kind.Global

int address_kind(Kind kind)
    if includes([Kind.Undo, Kind.Redo, Kind.History, Kind.Marks, Kind.Files, Kind.Edit], kind)
        return 0
    if includes([Kind.Append, Kind.Insert, Kind.Put, Kind.Equal, Kind.Read, Kind.Mark, Kind.Page], kind)
        return 1
    return 2

bool action_modifies(Kind kind)
    return includes([Kind.Append, Kind.Insert, Kind.Change, Kind.Delete, Kind.Put, Kind.Join, Kind.JoinWords, Kind.Move, Kind.Copy, Kind.Substitute, Kind.Indent, Kind.Outdent, Kind.LetterCase, Kind.Sort, Kind.Read, Kind.Edit], kind)

bool modifying(const Action | Global command)
    match command
        Action action
            return action_modifies(action.kind)
        Global global
            return action_modifies(global.action.kind)

string | error choose_pattern(State &state, string search)
    if search != ""
        state.pattern = search
    match state.pattern
        string remembered
            return remembered
        none
            return error("no previous pattern")

int locate(const Line[] buffer, int identity)
    for: index < #buffer
        if buffer[index].id == identity
            return int(index) + 1
    return 0

int | error address_value(State &state, const Token[] tokens)
    value := state.current
    for token := tokens[]
        if token.kind == TokenKind.Offset
            int magnitude := if #token.word == 1 then 1 else int(token.word[1:])
            value += if token.word[0] == "+" then magnitude else -magnitude
        elif token.kind == TokenKind.Number
            value = int(token.word)
        elif token.kind == TokenKind.Current
            value = state.current
        elif token.kind == TokenKind.Last
            value = int(#state.buffer)
        elif token.kind == TokenKind.Mark
            if #token.word != 1 or not "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz".contains(token.word)
                return error("invalid mark")
            value = locate(state.buffer, state.marks[token.word.codepoints()[0] - 97])
            if value == 0
                return error("mark not set")
        else
            pattern := try choose_pattern(&state, token.word)
            size := int(#state.buffer)
            pivot := if token.kind == TokenKind.Backward and state.current == 0 then size + 1 else state.current
            value = 0
            for: 1 <= step <= size
                index := if token.kind == TokenKind.Forward then (pivot + step - 1) % size else (pivot - step - 1 + size) % size
                if state.buffer[index].text.contains(pattern)
                    value = index + 1
                    break
            if value == 0
                return error("no match")
    return value

int[] | error address_values(State &state, const Addresses form)
    if form.count == 0
        return []
    left := if #form.left == 0 then (if form.semicolon then state.current else 1) else try address_value(&state, form.left)
    if form.count == 1
        return [left]
    if form.semicolon
        if left < 0 or left > int(#state.buffer)
            return error("address out of range")
        state.current = left
    right := if #form.right == 0 then int(#state.buffer) else try address_value(&state, form.right)
    return [left, right]

LineRange | error checked_range(const State state, Kind kind, const int[] values)
    arity := address_kind(kind)
    size := int(#state.buffer)
    if arity == 0
        return LineRange(0, 0)
    if arity == 1
        first := state.current
        if #values > 0
            first = values[0]
        elif kind == Kind.Equal or kind == Kind.Read
            first = size
        elif kind == Kind.Page
            first += 1
        minimum := if kind == Kind.Mark or kind == Kind.Page then 1 else 0
        if first < minimum or first > size
            return error("address out of range")
        return LineRange(first, first)
    first := state.current
    last := first
    if #values == 1
        first = values[0]
        last = first
    elif #values == 2
        first = values[0]
        last = values[1]
    elif includes([Kind.PrintWrite, Kind.Write, Kind.AppendFile, Kind.Count], kind)
        return LineRange(1, size)
    elif kind == Kind.Global or kind == Kind.Sort
        first = 1
        last = size
    elif kind == Kind.Join or kind == Kind.JoinWords
        last = first + 1
    if first < 1 or first > size or last < 1 or last > size
        return error("address out of range")
    if first > last or first == last and (kind == Kind.Join or kind == Kind.JoinWords)
        return error("invalid range")
    return LineRange(first, last)

Record snapshot(const State state, string source)
    return Record(source, state.buffer, state.current)

string[] contents(const State state, const LineRange range)
    return [for line := state.buffer[range.first - 1:<range.last][] then line.text]

Line[] new_lines(State &state, const string[] text)
    first := state.next_id
    state.next_id += int(#text)
    return [for index := (nat(0):<#text)[] then Line(first + int(index), text[index])]

void replace_lines(State &state, int position, int count, const Line[] inserted)
    state.buffer = state.buffer[0:<position].concat(inserted).concat(state.buffer[position + count:])

void add_line(Editor &editor, string text)
    editor.output = editor.output.append(text)

void print_line(Editor &editor, int number, string form)
    text := editor.state.buffer[number - 1].text
    if form == "n"
        label := string(number)
        add_line(&editor, " " * nat(math.max(0, 3 - int(#label))) + label + " " + text)
    elif form == "l"
        escaped := ""
        for: index < #text
            ch := text[index]
            escaped += if ch == "\" then "\\" else ch
        escaped += "$"
        while #escaped > 40
            add_line(&editor, escaped[0:<39] + "\")
            escaped = escaped[39:]
        add_line(&editor, escaped)
    else
        add_line(&editor, text)

void suffix_line(Editor &editor, string suffix)
    if suffix != "" and editor.state.current > 0
        print_line(&editor, editor.state.current, suffix)

int byte_count(const string[] text)
    return [for line := text[] then int(#line) + 1].sum()

int word_count(string text)
    return int(#[for word := text.split(" ")[] if word != "" then word])

int leading_spaces(string text)
    position := 0
    while position < int(#text) and text[position] == " "
        position += 1
    return position

string letter_case(string text, string option)
    result := ""
    int[] points := text.codepoints()
    for: index < #points
        point := points[index]
        if 97 <= point <= 122 and option != "l"
            result += "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ"[point - 97]
        elif 65 <= point <= 90 and option != "u"
            result += "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz"[point - 65]
        else
            result += text[index]
    return result

int leading_integer(string text)
    negative := text[0] == "-"
    start := if negative then 1 else 0
    finish := digits_end(text, start)
    if finish == start
        return 0
    magnitude := int(text[start:<finish])
    return if negative then -magnitude else magnitude

Line[] sorted_lines<Key>(const Line[] lines, const Key[] keys, bool descending, bool unique)
    ordered := keys.sorted(descending = descending)
    Line[] result := []
    for: position < #ordered
        if position > 0 and ordered[position] == ordered[position - 1]
            continue
        for: index < #keys
            if keys[index] == ordered[position]
                result = result.append(lines[index])
                if unique
                    break
    return result

int | error substitute(Editor &editor, const Action action, const LineRange range, bool inside)
    sub := action.substitution
    pattern := try choose_pattern(&editor.state, sub.search)
    replacement := sub.replacement
    if sub.previous
        match editor.state.replacement
            ReplacementPart[] remembered
                replacement = remembered
            none
                return error("no previous substitution")
    editor.state.replacement = replacement
    expanded := [for part := replacement[] then (if part.matched then pattern else part.text)].join("")
    changed := 0
    for: range.first <= number <= range.last
        original := editor.state.buffer[number - 1].text
        result := ""
        position := 0
        occurrence := 0
        replaced := false
        while true
            found := find_index(original[position:], pattern)
            if found < 0
                break
            found += position
            result += original[position:<found]
            occurrence += 1
            if occurrence == sub.count or sub.all and occurrence > sub.count
                result += expanded
                replaced = true
            else
                result += pattern
            position = found + int(#pattern)
        if replaced
            result += original[position:]
            if #result > 80
                return error("line too long")
            if result == "" or result.ends_with(" ")
                return error("bad line")
            editor.state.buffer[number - 1].text = result
            editor.state.current = number
            changed += 1
    if changed == 0 and not inside
        return error("no match")
    if changed > 0
        suffix_line(&editor, action.suffix)
    return changed

void | error transfer_history(State &state, bool redo, int amount)
    source := if redo then state.redo else state.undo
    target := if redo then state.undo else state.redo
    if amount > int(#source)
        return error(if redo then "nothing to redo" else "nothing to undo")
    for: 0 <= repetition < amount
        saved := source[#source - 1]
        source = source[0:<int(#source) - 1]
        target = target.append(snapshot(state, saved.source))
        state.buffer = saved.buffer
        state.current = saved.current
    if redo
        state.redo = source
        state.undo = target
    else
        state.undo = source
        state.redo = target
    return void

void | error file_command(Editor &editor, const Action action, const LineRange range)
    string[] file_text := []
    exists := false
    match editor.state.files.get(action.argument)
        string[] saved
            file_text = saved
            exists = true
        none
            exists = false
    if action.kind == Kind.Write or action.kind == Kind.AppendFile
        selected := contents(editor.state, range)
        file_text = if action.kind == Kind.AppendFile then file_text.concat(selected) else selected
        .editor.state.files.set(action.argument, file_text)
    else
        if not exists
            return error("no such file")
        inserted := new_lines(&editor.state, file_text)
        if action.kind == Kind.Read
            replace_lines(&editor.state, range.first, 0, inserted)
            editor.state.current = range.first + int(#file_text)
        else
            editor.state.buffer = inserted
            editor.state.current = int(#file_text)
    add_line(&editor, "file {action.argument} lines={#file_text} bytes={byte_count(file_text)}")
    return void

int | error execute_action(Editor &editor, const Action action, const LineRange range, const string[] text, inside := false)
    kind := action.kind
    first := range.first
    last := range.last
    if kind == Kind.PrintLast
        print_line(&editor, last, "p")
        editor.state.current = last
    elif kind == Kind.Print or kind == Kind.Numbered or kind == Kind.List
        form := if kind == Kind.Print then "p" elif kind == Kind.Numbered then "n" else "l"
        for: first <= number <= last
            print_line(&editor, number, form)
        editor.state.current = last
    elif kind == Kind.Page
        if action.amount >= 0
            editor.state.display_count = action.amount
        end := math.min(int(#editor.state.buffer), first + editor.state.display_count - 1)
        for: first <= number <= end
            print_line(&editor, number, "p")
        editor.state.current = end
    elif kind == Kind.Equal
        add_line(&editor, string(first))
    elif kind == Kind.Count
        selected := contents(editor.state, range)
        words := [for line := selected[] then word_count(line)].sum()
        characters := [for line := selected[] then int(#line)].sum()
        add_line(&editor, "count lines={#selected} words={words} chars={characters}")
    elif kind == Kind.PrintWrite
        selected := contents(editor.state, range)
        for line := selected[]
            add_line(&editor, line)
        add_line(&editor, "lines={#selected} bytes={byte_count(selected)}")
    elif kind == Kind.Append or kind == Kind.Insert
        position := if kind == Kind.Append then first else math.max(first, 1) - 1
        inserted := new_lines(&editor.state, text)
        replace_lines(&editor.state, position, 0, inserted)
        editor.state.current = position + int(#text)
    elif kind == Kind.Change or kind == Kind.Delete
        editor.state.cut = contents(editor.state, range)
        Line[] inserted := []
        if kind == Kind.Change
            inserted = new_lines(&editor.state, text)
        replace_lines(&editor.state, first - 1, last - first + 1, inserted)
        editor.state.current = if #inserted > 0 then first + int(#inserted) - 1 else math.min(first, int(#editor.state.buffer))
    elif kind == Kind.Yank
        editor.state.cut = contents(editor.state, range)
    elif kind == Kind.Put
        if #editor.state.cut == 0
            return error("nothing to put")
        inserted := new_lines(&editor.state, editor.state.cut)
        replace_lines(&editor.state, first, 0, inserted)
        editor.state.current = first + int(#inserted)
    elif kind == Kind.Move or kind == Kind.Copy
        destination := try address_value(&editor.state, action.destination)
        if destination < 0 or destination > int(#editor.state.buffer)
            return error("address out of range")
        if kind == Kind.Move and first <= destination < last
            return error("invalid destination")
        selected := editor.state.buffer[first - 1:<last]
        position := destination
        if kind == Kind.Move
            replace_lines(&editor.state, first - 1, last - first + 1, [])
            if destination >= last
                position -= int(#selected)
        else
            selected = new_lines(&editor.state, [for line := selected[] then line.text])
        replace_lines(&editor.state, position, 0, selected)
        editor.state.current = position + int(#selected)
    elif kind == Kind.Join or kind == Kind.JoinWords
        selected := contents(editor.state, range)
        if kind == Kind.JoinWords
            for: 1 <= index < #selected
                selected[index] = selected[index][leading_spaces(selected[index]):]
        joined := selected.join(if kind == Kind.Join then "" else " ")
        if #joined > 80
            return error("line too long")
        line := editor.state.buffer[first - 1]
        line.text = joined
        replace_lines(&editor.state, first - 1, last - first + 1, [line])
        editor.state.current = first
    elif kind == Kind.Indent or kind == Kind.Outdent or kind == Kind.LetterCase
        width := if action.amount < 0 then 4 else action.amount
        for: first <= number <= last
            line := editor.state.buffer[number - 1].text
            if kind == Kind.Indent
                if int(#line) + width > 80
                    return error("line too long")
                line = " " * nat(width) + line
            elif kind == Kind.Outdent
                line = line[math.min(width, leading_spaces(line)):]
            else
                line = letter_case(line, action.argument)
            editor.state.buffer[number - 1].text = line
        editor.state.current = last
    elif kind == Kind.Sort
        selected := editor.state.buffer[first - 1:<last]
        descending := action.argument.contains("r")
        unique := action.argument.contains("u")
        if action.argument.contains("n")
            keys := [for line := selected[] then leading_integer(line.text)]
            selected = sorted_lines(selected, keys, descending, unique)
        else
            keys := [for line := selected[] then (if action.argument.contains("i") then letter_case(line.text, "l") else line.text)]
            selected = sorted_lines(selected, keys, descending, unique)
        replace_lines(&editor.state, first - 1, last - first + 1, selected)
        editor.state.current = first + int(#selected) - 1
    elif kind == Kind.Substitute
        return try substitute(&editor, action, range, inside)
    elif kind == Kind.Mark
        editor.state.marks[action.argument.codepoints()[0] - 97] = editor.state.buffer[first - 1].id
    elif kind == Kind.Marks
        string[] parts := []
        for: 0 <= index < 26
            position := locate(editor.state.buffer, editor.state.marks[index])
            if position > 0
                parts = parts.append("abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz"[index] + "={position}")
        add_line(&editor, "marks " + (if #parts == 0 then "none" else parts.join(" ")))
    elif kind == Kind.Undo or kind == Kind.Redo
        try transfer_history(&editor.state, kind == Kind.Redo, if action.amount < 0 then 1 else action.amount)
    elif kind == Kind.History
        add_line(&editor, "history undo={#editor.state.undo} redo={#editor.state.redo}")
        for: 0 <= direction < 2
            history := if direction == 0 then editor.state.undo else editor.state.redo
            label := if direction == 0 then "undo" else "redo"
            for: index < #history
                saved := history[int(#history) - 1 - int(index)]
                add_line(&editor, "{label} {index + 1}: {saved.source}")
    elif includes([Kind.Read, Kind.Write, Kind.AppendFile, Kind.Edit], kind)
        try file_command(&editor, action, range)
    elif kind == Kind.Files
        string[] parts := []
        for name := editor.state.files.keys().sorted()[]
            match editor.state.files.get(name)
                string[] saved
                    parts = parts.append("{name}={#saved}")
                none
                    continue
        add_line(&editor, "files " + (if #parts == 0 then "none" else parts.join(" ")))
    if includes([Kind.Delete, Kind.Put, Kind.Join, Kind.JoinWords, Kind.Move, Kind.Copy], kind)
        suffix_line(&editor, action.suffix)
    return 0

void | error apply_command(Editor &editor, string source, const string[] text)
    before := snapshot(editor.state, source)
    scanned := try scan_address(source)
    form := try address_form(scanned.tokens)
    Action | Global command := try parse_command(scanned.tail)
    kind := command_kind(command)
    arity := address_kind(kind)
    if arity == 0 and form.count > 0
        return error("unexpected address")
    if arity == 1 and form.count == 2
        return error("too many addresses")
    values := try address_values(&editor.state, form)
    range := try checked_range(editor.state, kind, values)
    match command
        Action action
            changed := try execute_action(&editor, action, range, text)
        Global global
            pattern := try choose_pattern(&editor.state, global.search)
            selected := [for line := editor.state.buffer[range.first - 1:<range.last][] if line.text.contains(pattern) != global.inverse then line.id]
            if #selected == 0
                return error("no match")
            changed := 0
            for identity := selected[]
                position := locate(editor.state.buffer, identity)
                if position == 0
                    continue
                editor.state.current = position
                subrange := try checked_range(editor.state, global.action.kind, [])
                changed += try execute_action(&editor, global.action, subrange, text, inside = true)
            if global.action.kind == Kind.Substitute and changed == 0
                return error("no match")
    if #editor.state.buffer > 200
        return error("buffer full")
    if modifying(command)
        editor.state.undo = editor.state.undo.append(before)
        editor.state.redo = []
    return void

string[] process_command(Editor &editor, string source, const string[] text)
    saved := editor.state
    editor.output = []
    void | error result := apply_command(&editor, source, text)
    match result
        void
            return editor.output
        error problem
            editor.state = saved
            editor.output = []
            return ["? " + problem.message]

line_editor := Editor()
while true
    string source_line
    scan(&source_line)
    if source_line == "Q"
        break
    string[] entered_text := []
    if with_text(source_line)

            scan(&entered_line)
            if entered_line == "."

    for output_line := process_command(&line_editor, source_line, entered_text)[]
